notes.subject: ol rong
notes.rationale: חטאות em i ol rong, em i tok bilong ol samting man i wokim nating

notes.subject: למען טובך
notes.rationale: long Tok Pisin, 'long gutpela pasin bilong yu' — tok bilong mune long Hibru

notes.subject: yu
notes.rationale: אתה i stap long Hibru, tasol mi no putim 'yu' long translation bikos em i no stret long Tok Pisin sentens

translation: Ol rong bilong taim yong bilong mi, na ol pasin bilong go het long narapela rot — no ken samapim olgeta ⟨em⟩; long strong bilong khesed bilong yu, samapim ⟨את⟩ mi; long gutpela pasin bilong yu, Yahwe.

tokens.gloss: na ol pasin bilong go het long narapela rot
long strong bilong khesed bilong yu
